name: Perplexica
tagline: Open-source self-hosted AI search engine combining local LLMs with SearxNG for cited web answers.
real_test_summary: Tested running Perplexica with local Ollama models and a local SearxNG instance. Retrieves real-time web sources and summarizes cited answers without tracking search history.
pros: Replicates Perplexity-style cited research using local Ollama models
Includes focus modes for academic papers, YouTube, Reddit, and web search
MIT license with straightforward Docker Compose deployment
cons: Requires internet access for live web search queries even when LLM runs locally
Answer synthesis speed depends on local model size and context length
